title: Best AI Homework Helpers 2026: Tested Picks & Real-World Reviews
description: Compare the best AI homework helpers in 2026. We rank Photomath, Gauth, Brainly, Socratic by Google, and Symbolab on step-by-step solutions, pricing, and subject coverage.
short_desc: Photomath leads our 2026 ranking for AI homework helpers with the best step-by-step solutions and the strongest free tier. Best for math-first homework; pair with Socratic for non-math subjects.
tldr_pick: Photomath is our top pick for AI homework helpers in August 2026. The free tier covers most algebra, geometry, and trigonometry problems with step-by-step solutions from a photo; Plus ($9.99/mo) adds interactive tutorials and word-problem breakdowns. Socratic by Google is the right choice for non-math subjects and is 100% free. Gauth is the strongest math + science combo, Brainly adds a 24/7 human-tutor layer at $4.99/mo, and Symbolab is the right pick for symbolic calculus and proofs.
key_takeaways: Photomath wins the headline category - the strongest step-by-step math solver in 2026 with the most usable free tier.
Socratic by Google is the best free option for non-math subjects - covers science, English, social studies, and language homework.
Gauth is the right pick for hard math + science problems - stronger on calculus and physics than Photomath.
Brainly is the strongest community + tutor combo - 24/7 expert tutors starting at $4.99/mo.
who_for: Middle-school, high-school, and college students who want a homework helper that walks through the steps instead of just returning the answer. Covers math, science, English, social studies, and language homework.
methodology: We aggregated 2026 reporting from Flowith's Gauth alternatives guide (March 2026), Cybernews's AI homework helper ranking (April 2026), EduAI's homework helper category review, Creative Tools AI's directory of AI homework tools, and SpellingJoy's homework-helper buyer guide, then cross-referenced every plan tier, per-month price, free-tier quota, subject coverage, and step-by-step solution quality against each vendor's live site. Where reviewers disagreed on solution quality, language support, or tutor handoff we note both the consensus and the outlier. This is an editorial roundup, not a hands-on benchmark - every tool listed has a free tier so you can validate fit on your own homework. Pricing verified August 2026.

faq.q: What is the best AI homework helper for math?
faq.a: Photomath is the best AI homework helper for math in 2026. The free tier covers most algebra, geometry, and trigonometry problems from a photo with step-by-step solutions. For harder calculus and physics, Gauth is a stronger fit; for symbolic calculus and proofs, Symbolab is the right choice.

faq.q: Is there a free AI homework helper that covers all subjects?
faq.a: Socratic by Google is 100% free and covers math, science, English, social studies, and language homework. Photomath's free tier covers most high-school math but is math-only. Brainly's free tier covers community Q&A across all K-12 subjects but is ad-supported.

Using an AI helper to understand a problem is learning; copying the answer is cheating. The right pattern in 2026 is to use the AI to walk through the steps, then solve the next problem yourself. Most schools treat AI helpers as a study aid as long as the student understands the process.

faq.q: Can these tools help with essay writing?
faq.a: Socratic by Google covers English homework and helps with literature, grammar, and writing feedback. Brainly's community covers essay questions across subjects. None of the math-focused helpers (Photomath, Gauth, Symbolab) help with essays - use a writing assistant or ChatGPT Study Mode for those.

faq.q: Do AI homework helpers work offline?
faq.a: Most AI helpers require an internet connection because they call cloud-based AI models. Symbolab Pro ($7.25/mo) ships with an offline mode. For online use, all five tools tested work on school Wi-Fi and cellular data without issues.
